description: Give the exact registry names of the MCP servers you connect (or plan to). Returns which of them share tool definitions, a remote endpoint or a registry description, compared on the same measurement day, and how many other listings share each one's tool definitions. Facts only, not a judgement. If two share tool definitions, clients that load tool definitions into context may load them twice.
name: check_overlap
title: Check your MCP servers for matching tool definitions
